The '''children of the Jedi''' were a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainees and dozens of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] that fled the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] around the time of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The group included a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who played a [[Mandolin/Legends|mandolin]]; [[Margolis Mingla]], a young girl who helped care for the children; the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Brigantes Ustu]]; as well as [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]], [[Hoddas Umgil]], the Ismaren siblings [[Lagan Ismaren|Lagan]] and [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda]]<ref name="COJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> and their [[Ismaren parents|parents]].<ref name="TEP">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> Of the dozens of children in the group, although most were Human, there were also [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]].<ref name="COJ" />

The group found refuge with the Ho'Din [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]], who had lived an isolated life on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for seventy [[Standard year/Legends|years]] was able to shelter the Jedi in [[Plett's House|his compound]]. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the location of the children and dispatched the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' to destroy them. [[Callista Ming|Callista Masana]] and [[Geith Eris]], two [[Altisian Jedi]] who had been in contact with Plett, were able to board the dreadnaught while it was traveling through the [[Moonflower Nebula/Legends|Moonflower Nebula]] and disable it. When the dreadnaught failed to arrive, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] dispatched a small strike force to attack. Plett and the Jedi were able to repel the fighters using [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]]. Plett and the children subsequently fled Belsavis and separated.<ref name="COJ" />

Of the scattered Jedi refugees, the siblings Lagan and Roganda Ismaren were captured by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Ameesa Darys]]. She killed Lagan and subverted Roganda to the dark side. She became one of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]].<ref name="TEP" /> Another of the Jedi children, Nichos Marr, later trained as a Jedi at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] for a short time before succumbing to the fatal [[Quannot's Syndrome]]. Among the other survivors of the Jedi children, knowledge of Plett's Well was suppressed, although its existence was known of by the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]].<ref name="COJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|He'd been living here for some seventy years before the other Jedi brought their spouses and children here to hide.|Jevax|<ref name="COJ" />}}
This refugee group was created by [[Barbara Hambly]] for her novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] ([[1995]]). Written before the release of the prequel movies and their taboo on marriage, the "Children of the Jedi" were originally understood as spouses and children of Jedi Knights. However, ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' ([[2002]]), published after the prequel movies, [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the children into [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] from the Jedi Temple.
